senses.gloss: † स्रेक् स्रेक्, सेक् सेक्, श्रेक् श्रेक्, स्वेक् स्वेक्, i. 1, Ātm. To go.

श्रेणि श्रेणि, i. e. श्रि + नि, m., f., and णी, f.
 1. A line, a row, Lass. 67, 10; 69, 8.
 2. A troop, Utt. Rāmac. 117, 6; Chr. 34, 13 (णी); Bhartṛ. 2, 28 (णी; भुवन-, all the worlds); ib. 71 (णि; उपकार-, plenty of benefits); Rājat. 5, 331 (शिरस्-श्रेणि, a great quantity of heads).
 3. A company of artisans following the same business, Bhāg. P. 9, 10, 38.
 4. A corporation, Man. 8, 41.
 5. A bucket, a baling vessel.
 --Comp.

श्रेयंस् श्रेयंस्, akin to श्री,
 I. Comparat. of प्रशस्य (see शंस्).
 1. Better, Hit. iii. d. 3.
 2. Best, Pañc. iii. d. 55; excellent, most beloved, Hit. iii. d. 34. acc. n. यस्, adv. Well, most excellent; with न, Rather--than, Rām. 3, 48, 16.
 II. f. यसि, The name of several plants.
 III. n. यस्.
 1. Prosperity, Pañc. 182, 1; fortune, Vikr. 68, 7 (pl.); happiness, Pañc. i. d. 344; Kir. 5, 49 (pl.).
 2. Final happiness.
 3. Virtue.
 4. An act leading to the chief temporal good, Man. 3, 223, 224.
 --Comp.

ऽश्रेयस -श्रेयस् + अ, in निस्-, n. Final beatitude, Man. 1, 117; 12, 83; 104. 2. श्वस्-,
 I. adj. Happy.
 II. ˚सम्, adv. Well.
 III. n.
 1. Happiness.
 2. Brahman.

श्रेयस्कर श्रेयस्कर, i. e. श्रेयंस्-कृ + अ, adj.
 1. Effecting happiness, Pañc. 73, 19.
 2. Ensuring felicity, Man. 7, 88.
 3. Making better.
 4. Propitious.

श्रेयस्त्व श्रेयस्त्व, i. e. श्रेयंस् + त्व, n.
 1. Superiority, Man. 10, 66.
 2. Final beatitude.

श्रेष्ठ श्रेष्ठ,
 I. Superl. of श्रेयंस्. []
 1. Best, excellent, Lass. 40, 6; of a higher rank, Pañc. iii. d. 219.
 2. Oldest, senior.
 3. Superl. श्रेष्ठ + तम, The very best, Hit. iii. d. 87.
 II. m.
 1. A king.
 2. A Brāhmaṇa.
 3. Kuvera.
 III. n. Cow's milk.
 --Comp.
श्रेष्ठता श्रेष्ठ + ता, f. Superiority, eminence, Man. 4, 245.

श्रेष्ठिन् श्रेष्ठिन्, i. e. श्रेष्ठ + इन्,
 I. adj. Best.
 II. m.
 1. An artist eminent by birth.
 2. The head of a body of persons following the same business, Pañc. 234, 6; i. d. 14, read ˚ठी; Daśak. in Chr. 184, 12.
